sealed_record.thesis: PONS is a Robinhood-chain token whose burn engine functions as a live revenue meter: fees accumulate, swap, and burn roughly every ~15 minutes, so the burn rate mechanically tracks trading volume in real time, with buyback pressure concentrated in US hours. Over 204M (~20.4% of supply) has already been burned and a further $500k+ has queued for burning. This is a genuinely under-covered, structurally deflationary asset tied to real on-chain activity rather than pure narrative rotation — the value-accrual mechanism is a fundamental fact that a single day's price print cannot falsify. Accumulate on the deflationary/cash-flow-linked thesis; unleveraged to hold through volatility without liquidation risk.
